[cols="1,4,1,6", options="header"]
.Register Map
|===
| Address | Name | Access | Description
| 0x0 | ALERT_TEST | W a| -
| 0x4 | WKUP_CTRL | RW a| -
| 0x8 | WKUP_THOLD_HI | RW a| -
| 0xC | WKUP_THOLD_LO | RW a| -
| 0x10 | WKUP_COUNT_HI | RW a| -
| 0x14 | WKUP_COUNT_LO | RW a| -
| 0x18 | WDOG_REGWEN | RW a| -
| 0x1C | WDOG_CTRL | RW a| -
| 0x20 | WDOG_BARK_THOLD | RW a| -
| 0x24 | WDOG_BITE_THOLD | RW a| -
| 0x28 | WDOG_COUNT | RW a| -
| 0x2C | INTR_STATE | RW a| -
| 0x30 | INTR_TEST | W a| -
| 0x34 | WKUP_CAUSE | RW a| -
|===

[cols="1,3,1,1,6", options="header"]
.ALERT_TEST Register
|===
| Bits | Field | Access | Reset | Description
| 31:1 | `Reserved` | - | - a| Reserved
| 0 | `fatal_fault` | W | 0x0 a| Write 1 to trigger one alert event of this kind.
|===

[cols="1,3,1,1,6", options="header"]
.WKUP_CTRL Register
|===
| Bits | Field | Access | Reset | Description
| 31:13 | `Reserved` | - | - a| Reserved
| 12:1 | `prescaler` | RW | 0x0 a| Pre-scaler value for wakeup timer count
| 0 | `enable` | RW | 0x0 a| When set to 1, the wakeup timer will count
|===

[cols="1,3,1,1,6", options="header"]
.WKUP_THOLD_HI Register
|===
| Bits | Field | Access | Reset | Description
| 31:0 | `threshold_hi` | RW | 0x0 a| The count at which a wakeup interrupt should be generated, top 32 bits.
|===

[cols="1,3,1,1,6", options="header"]
.WKUP_THOLD_LO Register
|===
| Bits | Field | Access | Reset | Description
| 31:0 | `threshold_lo` | RW | 0x0 a| The count at which a wakeup interrupt should be generated, bottom 32 bits.
|===

[cols="1,3,1,1,6", options="header"]
.WKUP_COUNT_HI Register
|===
| Bits | Field | Access | Reset | Description
| 31:0 | `count_hi` | RW | 0x0 a| The current wakeup counter value, top 32 bits.
|===

[cols="1,3,1,1,6", options="header"]
.WKUP_COUNT_LO Register
|===
| Bits | Field | Access | Reset | Description
| 31:0 | `count_lo` | RW | 0x0 a| The current wakeup counter value, bottom 32 bits.
|===

[cols="1,3,1,1,6", options="header"]
.WDOG_REGWEN Register
|===
| Bits | Field | Access | Reset | Description
| 31:1 | `Reserved` | - | - a| Reserved
| 0 | `regwen` | RW | 0x1 a| Once cleared, the watchdog configuration will be locked until the next reset.
|===

[cols="1,3,1,1,6", options="header"]
.WDOG_CTRL Register
|===
| Bits | Field | Access | Reset | Description
| 31:2 | `Reserved` | - | - a| Reserved
| 1 | `pause_in_sleep` | RW | 0x0 a| When set to 1, the watchdog timer will not count during sleep.
| 0 | `enable` | RW | 0x0 a| When set to 1, the watchdog timer will count.
|===

[cols="1,3,1,1,6", options="header"]
.WDOG_BARK_THOLD Register
|===
| Bits | Field | Access | Reset | Description
| 31:0 | `threshold` | RW | 0x0 a| The count at which a watchdog bark interrupt should be generated.
|===

[cols="1,3,1,1,6", options="header"]
.WDOG_BITE_THOLD Register
|===
| Bits | Field | Access | Reset | Description
| 31:0 | `threshold` | RW | 0x0 a| The count at which a watchdog bite reset should be generated.
|===

[cols="1,3,1,1,6", options="header"]
.WDOG_COUNT Register
|===
| Bits | Field | Access | Reset | Description
| 31:0 | `count` | RW | 0x0 a| The current watchdog counter value.
|===

[cols="1,3,1,1,6", options="header"]
.INTR_STATE Register
|===
| Bits | Field | Access | Reset | Description
| 31:2 | `Reserved` | - | - a| Reserved
| 1 | `wdog_timer_bark` | RW | 0x0 a| Raised if the watchdog timer has hit the bark threshold.
| 0 | `wkup_timer_expired` | RW | 0x0 a| Raised if the wakeup timer has hit the specified threshold.
|===

[cols="1,3,1,1,6", options="header"]
.INTR_TEST Register
|===
| Bits | Field | Access | Reset | Description
| 31:2 | `Reserved` | - | - a| Reserved
| 1 | `wdog_timer_bark` | W | - a| Write 1 to force wdog_timer_bark interrupt.
| 0 | `wkup_timer_expired` | W | - a| Write 1 to force wkup_timer_expired interrupt.
|===

[cols="1,3,1,1,6", options="header"]
.WKUP_CAUSE Register
|===
| Bits | Field | Access | Reset | Description
| 31:1 | `Reserved` | - | - a| Reserved
| 0 | `cause` | RW | 0x0 a| AON timer requested wakeup, write 0 to clear.
|===
